messages.subject: Binary Regression models
parts:
Dear INLA users,

I am new to  INLA. 

I fit a mixed probit regression model using,

fit.pm = inla(formula=formula, data=data, Ntrials =1, 
              family="binomial",
             control.predictor = list(compute=TRUE), 
             control.compute = list(dic=TRUE, waic=T),
             control.family = list(link='probit'))
summary(fit.pm)


I encoutered two problems:

1. Using the above code, the calculated DIC was infinite. How do I fix this?

2. How do I extract the posterior marginal probability of success for each observed response?

Thank you, I look forward to your comments

Regards
Fabiano
